messages:
leah: Hi — trying to set up the new hire onboarding for Platform team. I can view the 'Company Onboarding Template' but don't have edit. Also want to duplicate it into our Team Space (Platform > Playbooks). Who owns the canonical template and what's the recommended way to copy/move it without losing embeds/linked databases?

devex-bot: Hi leah — docs request form: https://redwood.company/docs-requests. If it's just permissions, ping @maria in this thread. If it's a template change, choose 'template update' in the form. :robot_face:

maria: hey leah — I'm the current owner for the company onboarding template. Quick steps:
1) Open the template page, click the ••• menu → 'Duplicate'.
2) Move the duplicated page into Platform > Playbooks (drag to workspace sidebar) — that preserves inline databases.
3) On the moved page click 'Share' → invite the 'Platform' Notion group with 'Can edit'.
4) Add your username to the 'Doc Owners' property at the top of the page (we use that prop to drive perms and rotas).

If you need private/upstream changes (affects everyone), file the docs request and mark it 'vendor impacting'.

ben: quick Q — does duplicating break any linked template variables or onboarding checklists that refer to the original page? We have a few linked tasks in the company task DB.

maria: good call. Duplicating will copy linked database views but NOT the rollup/relations to rows in other spaces. For any cross-space rollups, do this:
- Export the old relation rows as CSV and import into the target DB, or
- Better: open the target DB, add a new relation to the original DB and then run the docs migration script (we have a small helper in infra repo). Ping me and I'll run it if you don't want to deal with CSVs.

ashley: done — I duplicated and moved it, invited Platform group, and added leah as editor. thx!

leah: awesome, thanks everyone. One more — naming convention? Should I prefix with 'Platform — Onboarding (2026)' or 'Platform Playbook: Onboarding'?

jordan: use 'Platform — Onboarding (vYYYY-MM-DD)' for snapshots. For live playbooks use 'Platform Playbook — Onboarding' so search groups them. We also add a small header block 'Doc owner: <name>' and a 'Last updated' date property.

maria: last note: if this will be used for Private deployments onboarding, tag the page with the 'private-deploy' template tag and cc security@redwood for checklist review. :white_check_mark:

leah: done, cc'd security. thanks again! :wave:
